newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down or flat in wait for KGHM.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down or flat in wait for KGHM.

text.p: Polish shares were seen down for the fifth session running as investors awaited the public offering start on Monday of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz SA.
Some analysts said gains by large-cap stocks which fell on Thursday could push the main index up.

Analysts said Thursday's news that the lower house approved a bill offering the 15 National Investment Funds (NFIs) an income tax exemption for capital gains made on sales of firms in their portfolios could help spur their rebound on Friday. Metal pipe maker Huta Ferrum starts trade on the main market. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
